text:
Yes, under the standard rules: the host knows where the car is, always opens an unchosen door with a goat, and always offers the switch. Your first pick is right 1/3 of the time, and the host's reveal doesn't change that, so the other unopened door holds the car the remaining 2/3.

The assumptions matter. If the host opens a door at random and it happens to show a goat, switching and staying are both 1/2. If the host offers the switch only when you've picked the car, switching always loses.
